## Exercise 1

Create a boxplot from `cpm.data.filt`.

* Convert `cpm.data.filt` to tidy format using `reshap2::melt()` or `tidyr::pivot_longer()`. If you use the second one, remember to move row names into a column using `tibble:rownames_to_column(var="Gene")` and remove the column `Gene` in the function `tidyr::pivot_longer()`.
* Create a plot using ggplot.
* Add a layer `geom_jitter` with `alpha=0.5` and suitable value for `size`.
* Add a layer `geom_violin` with `alpha=0.5`.
* Add a layer `geom_boxplot` with `alpha=0.5` and a suitable  value for `width`.

```{r box-plot-filtered}
## Convert to tidy format using reshape::melt
box.data.tidy           <- melt(cpm.data.filt)
colnames(box.data.tidy) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "logCPM")

## convert to tidy format using tidyr::pivot_longer()
df <- cpm.data.filt %>% 
  as.data.frame %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "logCPM")

## create a plot
bp2 <- ggplot(box.data.tidy,aes(x=Sample, y=logCPM, color= Sample)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width = 0.45, alpha = 0.6)

## show the plo1
bp2
```
